title: Do We Need Asynchronous SGD? On the Near-Optimality of Synchronous Methods
summary: Modern distributed optimization methods mostly rely on traditional synchronous approaches, despite substantial recent progress in asynchronous optimization. We revisit Synchronous SGD and its robust variant, called $m$-Synchronous SGD, which can be interpreted as a method with a backup-worker strategy, and theoretically show that they are nearly optimal in many heterogeneous computation and communication scenarios, which is somewhat unexpected.
